title: The Example of the Rechabites

questions.question: In the days of Jehoiakim, the Lord told Jeremiah to go to the house of the... and bring them into one of the chambers of the house of the Lord and offer them wine.
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:2 (ESV): "Go to the house of the Rechabites and speak with them and bring them to the house of the Lord... and offer them wine to drink."

questions.question: When Jeremiah set pitchers full of wine and cups before the Rechabites, what did they say?
options: "We only drink water from our own well."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:6 (ESV): "But they answered, 'We will drink no wine...'"

questions.question: Who was their ancestor who had commanded them never to drink wine?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:6 (ESV): "for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, 'You shall not drink wine, neither you nor your sons forever.'"

questions.question: Besides not drinking wine, what else were the Rechabites commanded NOT to do?
options: Build a house, sow seed, or plant a vineyard
Ride a horse or drive a chariot
Eat meat or cut their hair
Speak to strangers or own gold
questions.correctAnswer: Build a house, sow seed, or plant a vineyard
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:7 (ESV): "You shall not build a house; you shall not sow seed; you shall not plant or have a vineyard; but you shall live in tents all your days,"

questions.question: Why did Jonadab command them to live in tents all their days?
options: "That you may live many days in the land where you sojourn."
"Because you are warriors of the Lord."
"To escape the judgments on the cities."
questions.correctAnswer: "That you may live many days in the land where you sojourn."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:7 (ESV): "that you may live many days in the land where you sojourn."

questions.question: Why were the Rechabites currently living in Jerusalem, despite the command to live in tents?
options: Because of the armies of the Chaldeans and Syrians
Because there was a famine in the land
To hide from the King of Ammon
questions.correctAnswer: Because of the armies of the Chaldeans and Syrians
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:11 (ESV): "But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against the land, we said, 'Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans and the army of the Syrians.'"

questions.question: The Lord told Jeremiah to go and say to the men of Judah: "Will you not receive... and listen to my words?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:13 (ESV): "Will you not receive instruction and listen to my words? declares the Lord."

questions.question: What contrast did the Lord make between the Rechabites and the men of Judah?
options: The Rechabites obeyed their earthly father, but Judah has not obeyed their Heavenly Father.
The Rechabites drank no wine, but Judah was always drunk.
The Rechabites lived in the desert, but Judah lived in luxury.
The Rechabites fought the Babylonians, but Judah surrendered.
questions.correctAnswer: The Rechabites obeyed their earthly father, but Judah has not obeyed their Heavenly Father.
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:14 (ESV): "The command that Jonadab the son of Rechab gave to his sons, to drink no wine, has been kept... but I have spoken to you persistently, and you have not listened to me."

questions.question: "I have sent to you all my servants the prophets... saying, 'Turn now, every one of you, from his evil way, and amend your deeds... ' But you did not... "
options: Incline your ear or listen to me
questions.correctAnswer: Incline your ear or listen to me
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:15 (ESV): "But you did not incline your ear or listen to me."

questions.question: "Therefore, thus says the Lord, the God of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I am bringing upon Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the... that I have pronounced against them,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:17 (ESV): "Behold, I am bringing upon Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the disaster that I have pronounced against them,"

questions.question: "Because I have spoken to them and they have not listened, I have... to them and they have not answered."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:17 (ESV): "I have called to them and they have not answered."

questions.question: Because the house of the Rechabites had faithfully kept the command of Jonadab their father, what promise did the Lord make to them?
options: Jonadab the son of Rechab shall never lack a man to stand before me
They will inherit the land of the Chaldeans
They will become the priests of the temple
They will be kings in Judah
questions.correctAnswer: Jonadab the son of Rechab shall never lack a man to stand before me
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:19 (ESV): "Jonadab the son of Rechab shall never lack a man to stand before me."

questions.question: The Rechabites had completely abstained from what beverage in obedience to their ancestor?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:14 (ESV): "...The command that Jonadab the son of Rechab gave to his sons, to drink no wine, has been kept, and they drink none to this day..."

questions.question: Into whose chamber in the temple did Jeremiah take the Rechabites to offer them wine?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:4 (ESV): "I brought them into the house of the Lord into the chamber of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God,"

questions.question: Where was this chamber of the sons of Hanan located?
options: Beside the chamber of the officials, above the chamber of Maaseiah
questions.correctAnswer: Beside the chamber of the officials, above the chamber of Maaseiah
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 35:4 (ESV): "which was beside the chamber of the officials, above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, keeper of the threshold."

key_verse_text: "The command that Jonadab the son of Rechab gave to his sons, to drink no wine, has been kept, and they drink none to this day, for they have obeyed their father's command. I have spoken to you persistently, but you have not listened to me."
